mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 80 degrees down by Harriet Park, and we have a Waxing Crescent moon tonight.

The City of Verona Common Council recently approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure our infrastructure remains self-supporting, and the Planning Department is reminding everyone to watch for scam emails requesting online payments for fees.

We have a lot going on with the Epic Systems User Group Meeting today, plus trivia events at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or join the fun at The Bogey Factory for trivia.
In a noteworthy call from Friday, August 15, officers arrested a woman for an O W I after she was found asleep at the wheel and subsequently began driving.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy our flavor of the day, Caramel Chocolate Pecan. The store is open until 10 PM, so come by and grab a treat while you can.
